description: Figure 9 is a grouped vertical bar chart titled “Comprehensive Evaluation Results on Academic and Practical Benchmarks,” illustrating model scores across multiple datasets/metrics for four model variants. The horizontal axis contains the categorical benchmarks labeled (left to right) GSM-8K, MMLU, HumanEval, TruthfulQA, ARC, MBPP, LC AlpacaEval-2, MT-Bench (+5), and Chat-Arena-Hard, with the axis label “Dataset and Metrics”; the categories appear in a fixed (not explicitly sorted) order. The vertical axis is labeled “Score (%)” and uses a linear scale from 0 to 80 with regularly spaced tick marks at 10-point intervals. Each category shows four adjacent bars corresponding to the legend “Model”: LLaMA-3-8B-it (blue), Ours (SFT baseline) (orange), Ours (DPO baseline) (green), and Ours (Iterative RLHF) (red). Approximate bar heights by category are: GSM-8K ~79 (blue), ~75 (orange), ~79 (green), ~80 (red); MMLU ~66 (blue), ~65 (orange), ~65 (green), ~65 (red); HumanEval ~61 (blue), ~64 (orange), ~63 (green), ~64 (red); TruthfulQA ~45 (blue), ~54 (orange), ~61 (green), ~60 (red); ARC ~59 (blue), ~61 (orange), ~63 (green), ~65 (red); MBPP ~60 (blue), ~62 (orange), ~61 (green), ~60 (red); LC AlpacaEval-2 ~23 (blue), ~10 (orange), ~22 (green), ~31 (red); MT-Bench (+5) ~41 (blue), ~40 (orange), ~42 (green), ~43 (red); Chat-Arena-Hard ~20 (blue), ~5 (orange), ~22 (green), ~29 (red). The bars are not stacked, there are no visible error bars or annotations, and no bars appear specially emphasized beyond the color coding and the legend.
